title.zh: 【Ledger 供应链攻击据报扩展至欧洲，官方经销商售出硬件钱包发现间谍植入装置】
title.en: 【Ledger 供应链攻击据报扩展至欧洲，官方经销商售出硬件钱包发现间谍植入装置】

current_state.zh: A Ledger hardware wallet bought weeks earlier from an official European reseller was found to contain an unauthorized spy implant with suspicious wiring not present in genuine units, indicating physical tampering before sale, with suspected cases now reported across Asia, South America and Europe and no funds stolen so far.
current_state.en: A Ledger hardware wallet bought weeks earlier from an official European reseller was found to contain an unauthorized spy implant with suspicious wiring not present in genuine units, indicating physical tampering before sale, with suspected cases now reported across Asia, South America and Europe and no funds stolen so far.
